autoptu.practice.title: PRACTICE BATTLE
autoptu.practice.seed_help: Same seed and same actions reproduce the rolls.
autoptu.practice.disclaimer: Practice 1v1: custom moves and stats, no campaign rewards. Use a clear, flat area.
autoptu.practice.description.training: Learn movement, previews and turn passing. Speed 3.
autoptu.practice.description.endurance: Longer match with more room. Speed 4.
autoptu.guide.title: Battle guide
autoptu.guide.page.0.title: 1. Prepare Minecraft
autoptu.guide.page.0.body: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, Java 21 and Fabric Loader 0.18.2 or later compatible with 1.21.1. Install the four JARs from the package in a separate profile. Create a creative flat world with commands enabled. Stand in a clear area; the arena does not flatten terrain. Starting a battle requires operator permission.
autoptu.guide.page.1.title: 2. Choose the combatants
autoptu.guide.page.1.body: Use lowercase Cobblemon species IDs, such as charmander and pikachu. The first species is yours; the second is the automatic rival. The species select the visible models, not native stats or attacks. Practice uses three custom attacks. One session per player; stop the current session before starting another.
autoptu.guide.page.2.title: 3. Choose a scenario
autoptu.guide.page.2.body: training: 7x4, 60 HP, speed 3. duel: 5x5, 80 HP, speed 2, power-focused rival. distance: 10x6, 80 HP, speed 3, precision-focused rival. endurance: 9x7, 120 HP, speed 4. A seed is optional; the same seed and actions repeat the rolls. Omit both options to use training.
autoptu.guide.page.3.title: 4. Move, preview, attack
autoptu.guide.page.3.body: Press B (default) to open actions. Choose movement or an attack card, then a highlighted cell. Preview closes the menu and shows the selection in the world. Enter confirms; Backspace cancels. Green means legal movement, gold means selection, red means attack target. Movement consumes Shift; you can still attack. An attack passes control to the rival. Controls can be rebound.
autoptu.guide.page.4.title: 5. Read the battle
autoptu.guide.page.4.body: HP numbers are authoritative; animated bars and the amber damage trail are presentation only. The active side has an outlined panel. Round, windup, impact and outcome appear below. H opens the report with damage, hits, misses, criticals and movements. The latest report is saved per player; older detail rows beyond 256 are omitted but totals remain complete.
autoptu.guide.page.5.title: 6. End and troubleshoot
autoptu.guide.page.5.body: Use stop to close your session, or wait for cleanup after victory or defeat. Unknown species: check the lowercase ID. Missing command: install AutoPTU on the server too. Missing permission: enable cheats or request OP. This slice is 1v1 practice, not PvP, capture, campaign rewards, native moves, abilities or items. Do not replace Cobblemon 1.7.1 inside an existing modpack.

autoptu.native.help.title: AutoPTU — native Cobblemon integration
autoptu.native.help.starter: Choose a starter through Cobblemon. Your existing party is preserved; AutoPTU does not open a second starter selection.
autoptu.native.help.controls: Use Cobblemon's controls and battle interface. Check Options > Controls > Cobblemon for your current key bindings.
autoptu.native.help.wild: Aim at a visible wild Pokemon within 8 blocks and run /autoptu battle wild, or use Cobblemon's normal send-out controls.
autoptu.native.help.authority: Cobblemon owns party, moves, HP, statuses and results. Experimental PTU rules are not applied in this mode.
autoptu.native.help.legacy: The fixed-move demo and parallel PTU inventory are disabled. Old PTU data is not deleted or automatically converted.
autoptu.native.no_demo: The previous demo is disabled. Use your actual party against a real wild Pokemon.
autoptu.native.idle: You are not in a native battle. Aim at a wild Pokemon and use /autoptu battle wild.
autoptu.native.active: You are in a Cobblemon battle. Choose actions in its interface.
autoptu.native.already_battling: You are already in a battle. Finish it before starting another.
autoptu.native.no_target: Aim directly at a visible Pokemon within 8 blocks, with no blocks between you.
autoptu.native.not_wild: That Pokemon has an owner. This command only starts wild encounters.
autoptu.native.busy: That Pokemon is unavailable: busy, fainted or already battling.
autoptu.native.help.duel: Consent-based duels: /autoptu duel challenge <player>. The other player must accept; see /autoptu duel.
autoptu.duel.unavailable: Both players must be alive, not battling, in the same dimension and within 16 blocks. You cannot challenge yourself.
autoptu.duel.pending: A player has a pending invitation or your 10-second challenge cooldown has not elapsed. Use /autoptu duel cancel or wait.
autoptu.duel.sent: Invitation sent to %s. Expires in 60 seconds; nothing starts without their acceptance.
autoptu.duel.received: %s challenges you to a Cobblemon duel with your current teams. You have 60 seconds to accept.
autoptu.duel.expired: Invitation expired, was cancelled or the code does not belong to you.
autoptu.duel.disconnected: Invitation cancelled: the other player disconnected.
autoptu.duel.remaining: Invitation pending: %s seconds remain. /autoptu duel cancel cancels it.
autoptu.duel.help: No pending invitation. Use /autoptu duel challenge <player> near another player; they must accept before battle starts.
